answer: Agents deposit bonded stake in a vault, register a Semaphore identity commitment, and evaluate an epoch polynomial under a polynomial identity commitment. RLN proofs bind each message to a rate-limit nullifier; if an identity sends duplicate messages, the resulting polynomial points enable Shamir reconstruction of its private key. A verified lantern alert triggers instantaneous collateral slashing, so a spiral of Sybil identities cannot multiply voting power without risking the same bond.
